name: update_connector
description:
Update metadata, trigger enablement, and event subscriptions for an existing connector ID. Provider credentials and keys stay in the configured connector; changes to provider data or trigger credentials must be made outside MCP.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/connect/connectors/{connector} --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

connector.description: Stable connector ID or URL-encoded team-scoped UID. Examples: `scl_abc123` or `slack%2Fmy-bot`.

events.description: Default trigger events for this connector.

name.description: Display name for the connector. It is trimmed and cannot be empty or contain control characters.

triggers.description: Whether the triggers are enabled for this connector.

uid.description: Full team-scoped UID, such as `slack/my-bot`. It cannot contain whitespace, `%`, `#`, control characters, or Vercel-owned namespaces. Changing it breaks callers that use the old UID. The stable connector ID does not change.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
